summary: A throw from inside an async function body rejects the returned promise rather than synchronously throwing to the caller.

target.notes: The runtime representation must support arbitrary JavaScript rejection values, not only System.Exception.

caveats: Throws while evaluating call arguments occur before entering the async function and remain synchronous.

tests.name: throw before await rejects
tests.input: async function f(){ throw 3; } const p=f(); console.log('after'); p.catch(console.log);

tests.name: object rejection reason preserved
tests.input: const e={x:1}; async function f(){throw e} f().catch(v=>console.log(v===e));
